row:
I am a therapist with over 30 years of clinical experience gained in Poland, the United Kingdom, Norway, and France. I combine the perspectives of physiotherapy and massage therapy, and over the years I have developed my own therapeutic approach — along with many unique techniques and practical tools — as a result of decades of experience, dozens of completed trainings, and my own developed methods, all integrated into one coherent and practical system.
I do not believe in one-size-fits-all protocols. Instead, I teach clinical reasoning and individualized treatment planning, so you can select safe, effective, and appropriate techniques for each client. My goal is not only to demonstrate techniques, but also to help you understand the underlying causes of dysfunction, recognize overload patterns and compensations, and restore functional balance in the body. If you are looking to deepen your skills and improve your clinical outcomes, you are welcome to join my training.
